text: ＊は　つかれはてて　こんらんした！

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two parts, the first being the reason for the second. つかれはてて　こんらんした = 'was worn out and so became confused'.

patterns.name: 〜はてる
patterns.explanation: はてる added to a verb says it goes all the way to the end. つかれる 'get tired' becomes つかれはてる. つかれはてて = 'being completely worn out'.
